summary: Backend-only security audit retest. New suite tests/test_security_audit_fixes.py: 14/14 pass (SEC-001 demo secrets, SEC-002 public_base poisoning, SEC-003 file ownership + delivery-with-photo, coaching read auth, 30-day order token). SEC-001: bakery/Bakery2026 and drv-1 PIN 482913 work on the preview URL. With Host: dashlocal.app they get 401 'Wrong email or password' / 'Wrong phone number or PIN'. Admin still logs in on the live host. A new admin-set PIN for drv-3 works on the live host, and PIN 264871 was restored. SEC-002: forged X-Forwarded-Host or Host values (evil.com, evil.com:443, lookalike suffix, 'evil.com, <preview>') never change public_base, which stays https://arrivewise.preview.emergentagent.com. SEC-003: the uploader can view their photo before delivery. After delivery: admin, the route driver and the stop's merchant get 200. The other merchant, other drivers, a garbage token, a customer order token and a file token for another path get 401. The signed pod_photo_url from /track/{code}/verify works. Coaching read: 401 without sign-in, 403 for another driver or a merchant, 200 for the note's driver and admin, 404 for an unknown id. Order token exp-iat is 30 days. Regression across the 5 requested suites: 64 passed. Two coaching tests failed because conftest did not auto-attach admin to the now-authed endpoint; I fixed this in conftest and they pass. 3 failures in test_auth_merchant_report/test_privacy_compliance happened only under xdist -n 2 (another worker's admin/reset), and all 17 pass serially. The known TestDriverAuthz::test_own_route_and_stops failure was ignored as instructed. One new low-severity issue: deliver accepts any photo_path.

minor.issue: Non-pharmacy deliveries do not check photo_path. A driver can attach a file path they did not upload (for example another stop's proof photo, or a non-existent path). Attaching it makes owns_file() grant that driver, and that stop's merchant, access to the photo through route/merchant ownership. Confirmed by probe: drv-1 got 401 on an admin-uploaded file, then delivered their own stop with that path and got 200. Severity is low because paths are UUIDs and hard to guess. Fix: require db.files {storage_path: photo_path, uploaded_by: u.id} (admin exempt), or at least that the file exists and is not already used as pod_photo_path on another stop.

Uses the first, client-controlled X-Forwarded-Host value. Any host in CORS_ORIGINS is accepted, so a client can switch public_base between trusted hosts. Example: on live, sending X-Forwarded-Host: arrivewise.preview.emergentagent.com makes emailed links point at the preview app if the preview URL is in the live CORS_ORIGINS. Not exploitable to evil.com. Consider dropping the preview origin from production CORS_ORIGINS, or preferring Host / the last XFH hop.

action_items: Validate photo_path in POST /api/stops/{id}/deliver (non-pharmacy): it must exist in db.files with uploaded_by == the current user (admin exempt) and must not already be used as another stop's pod_photo_path.
Optional: harden remember_public_base so a client-controlled X-Forwarded-Host cannot switch between trusted origins, or keep the preview URL out of production CORS_ORIGINS.
critical_code_review_comments: is_preview() trusts the Host header. That is safe only if the production ingress never forwards a *.preview.emergentagent.com / *.preview.emergentcf.cloud / localhost Host to the live backend, which cannot be verified from preview. If production health checks or internal proxies use Host localhost, demo secrets would work for those requests. Not reachable by clients through the ingress.
owns_file uses find_one on pod_photo_path, so if the same path is attached to two stops only the first stop's merchant/driver is considered (see the deliver photo_path issue).
Testing a localhost login with Host: dashlocal.app writes public_base=https://dashlocal.app, which is correct for live. The test fixture restores the preview value afterwards.
backend.err.log has an old startup NameError (current_user not imported in routes/feedback.py) from development. It is fixed now (the import exists and the endpoint works).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/conftest.py (ADMIN_PATHS regex now includes coaching/[^/?]+/read so the legacy coaching suite auto-authenticates as admin)

success_rate.backend: 100% of new security tests (14/14); regression 64/70 under xdist with all non-known failures explained (2 test-infra, fixed; 3 xdist cross-worker races, pass serially; 1 known/ignored)

seed_data_creation: Tests deliver 1-2 pending stops on drv-1/drv-2 active routes and may tag one pending stop as merchant mer-1. Admin-uploaded TEST photos are stored in db.files. POST /api/admin/reset reseeds. The TEST_ coaching note is deleted. login_attempts are cleared, drv-3 PIN is restored to 264871 and public_base is restored to the preview URL.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Simulate the live host by calling http://localhost:8001 with header Host: dashlocal.app (plus X-No-Auto-Auth: 1 to bypass conftest admin auto-auth). Restore db.settings public_base to https://arrivewise.preview.emergentagent.com afterwards. File tests must send X-No-Auto-Auth: 1, because conftest auto-adds an admin bearer for /api/files/. Run suites that call admin/reset with -n 0 to avoid cross-worker races.
rca_of_issue: photo_path issue: deliver() only validates photo_path against db.files for pharmacy drops (routes/stops.py:185-191). Any other path string is saved as pod_photo_path, and owns_file() then treats the route driver and merchant as owners. Repro: tests/probe_iter39_photo_path_hijack.py.
